annotations.title: Simple meal ideas by goal, diet and meal, with rough macros

description: Simple meal ideas by goal, diet and meal, with rough macros. For requests like "give me a high protein halal dinner idea", "a quick vegan lunch", "cheap vegetarian breakfast ideas". Goals: high protein, low carb, budget, quick, high fibre. Diets: vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, halal. Meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack. The user's words can go in q instead. Ideas rotate daily. It does not set calorie or weight targets; a weight-loss request gets lighter, filling ideas (goal lighter, 450 calories or less) and a pointer to a doctor or dietitian, with no shop links.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the shop links (US, GB and IE get local Amazon links). Default from the request.

diet.description: Diet: vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian or halal.

goal.description: Goal: high protein, low carb, budget, quick or high fibre.

meal.description: Meal: breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack.

q.description: Free text, for example high protein halal dinner.
